convert_nanochat_checkpoint: convert a NanoChat model checkpoint from original format to HuggingFace format using input and output directories
write_model_convert: convert NanoChat model weights from original checkpoint to HuggingFace format with automatic key-value head inference
write_tokenizer_convert: convert a NanoChat tokenizer from pickle or JSON format to HuggingFace tokenizer format
run_test_generation: run a quick generation test on a converted NanoChat model with a given prompt to verify correctness
load_config_from_checkpoint: load a NanoChatConfig from meta_*.json or config.json in a checkpoint directory with parameter mapping
